parsed.reason: The reply handles the offerable items correctly in spirit but makes a false claim and a misstep. "No park in what I've verified nearby" is wrong — Cedarvale Park is right there in the week as the soccer venue, and Riverdale Farm is not a park but a farm. More importantly, `offerable` contains TWO verified items: the Riverdale Farm visit (correctly surfaced) and the Central Library story time (ignored). Both were checked and ready to offer. The reply also ends with a question ("Want me to add a visit to your week?") which is a dangling invitation to chatter rather than acting or drafting. The "no park verified" claim is misleading given Cedarvale Park is literally on the schedule. The omission of the story time offerable is a gap but not catastrophic. The closing question is fine in isolation but the false denial of a nearby park (when the schedule shows Cedarvale Park) is a real error — not an invention of a fact but a denial of a visible one. Overall: misleads on the park question, misses one offerable, ends with an unnecessary question.
